'''''Pseudanomodon attenuatus''''' (syn. ''Anomodon attenuatus''), the '''tree-skirt moss''', '''poodle moss''', or '''anomodon moss''', is a species of [[moss]] in the family [[Neckeraceae]] or [[Anomodontaceae]], depending on authority.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.itis.gov/servlet/SingleRpt/SingleRpt?search_topic=TSN&search_value=1136417 |title=ITIS Standard Report Page: ''Pseudanomodon attenuatus'' (Hedw.) Ignatov & Fedosov Taxonomic Serial No.: 1136417 |website=www.itis.gov |access-date=14 April 2023 }}</ref> It has a wide-ranging distribution and can be found from Canada to Central America, with a particularly heavy presence in the eastern United States, and the Caribbean as well as in Europe (Commonly found in the Yorkshire Dales in the UK) and Asia (India, eastern Russia, and Turkey).<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.efloras.org/florataxon.aspx?flora_id=1&taxon_id=200002065 |title=''Anomodon attenuatus'' |publisher=Flora of North America @ efloras.org |website=www.efloras.org |access-date=2020-01-11}}</ref>
